detector.name: Corn metrics
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.not_reporting import not_reporting
A = data('corn.test', filter=filter('corn.pod.name', 'pod')).sum(by=['corn.namespace.name', 'corn.cluster.name']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(84)), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Corn metric is > 84')
not_reporting.detector(stream=A, resource_identifier=None, duration='5m', auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Corn metric is not reporting')

rules.description: The value of plotName is above 84.
The signal plotName has not reported for 5m.
